facts.fact: TechCabal reports that in April 2026 Nigeria's Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission subjected airtime lending services such as MTN's to new licensing and consumer-protection requirements.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued an exposure draft of revised Consumer Protection Regulations 2.0 to address consumer risks from fintech delivery of financial services, with comments due 29 February 2024.

The FCCPC says the Digital, Electronic, Online or Non-Traditional Consumer Lending Regulations, 2025 are again fully operational and enforceable after the Federal High Court upheld them on 20 July 2026.

note: No fine or sanction reported.

facts.fact: The FCCPC says the Digital, Electronic, Online and Non-Traditional Consumer Lending Regulations, 2025 (DEON) apply to digital money lending operators, with a regularisation deadline of 5 January 2026.

The FCCPC says it began enforcement on 21 January 2026, withdrawing conditional approval from digital lenders that missed the DEON deadline and removing them from its published register of approved lenders.
